transcript: Ichabod Spellings appears to be a literary persona/heteronym rather than a conventional, independently documented author. The sources I found describe Spellings as an American writer associated with the 'New Human' literary movement and credit him with All That Lies Within Me, described as 'an autobiography composed by the cosmos.' [Medium +1] There is an important wrinkle: material from the same literary project explicitly treats Spellings as a heteronym—a constructed authorial identity. One account says Spellings 'emerges as a character' and describes an eventual transfer of authorship to another persona, Jack Feist. [Medium] The project itself is associated with Lee Sharks and a larger experimental/avant-garde archive involving figures such as Johannes Sigil and Jack Feist.
